title: Aquino and Phoenix program psychological warfare in Vietnam

tellings.quote: a psychological warfare operations officer in Vietnam, right? >> The Phoenix program. He was involved in the Phoenix program.

plain: A man named Michael Aquino is said to have been a psychological warfare officer in Vietnam who took part in the Phoenix program, a wartime US operation there. The writer Peter Levenda, who researches the CIA's hidden history, tells Michels this without naming a source, confirming that Aquino "was involved in the Phoenix program," in a conversation that also draws on Levenda's book The Lovecraft Code. Levenda raises it to tie Aquino's later life to military mind-war work.
